en.title: Count Subarrays Decreasing by 1 at Each Step
en.description:
Count only contiguous subarrays of length at least 2 in which every adjacent element decreases by exactly 1.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains the integers. The source only gives n≥1; on this site n≤200000 and −10^9≤element≤10^9.
hints: Maintain the length L of the decreasing run ending at the current position; it adds L−1 new valid subarrays.
